subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 12 updates

question: After the stale assertions are fixed and the branch is rebased, should the security-owned workflows accept these verified third-party action revisions, including Codex Action v1.11's Node 24 and permission-profile changes?
rationale: Several updated actions execute in secret-bearing or publication workflows, and the protected security label requires explicit owner acceptance even though upstream provenance and backward compatibility were verified.

options.title: Approve after guards and rebase
options.body: Accept the verified revisions once all three assertions are synchronized and exact-head workflow checks pass on a conflict-free branch.

options.title: Split privileged upgrades
options.body: Land ordinary setup pins separately and review Codex, app-token, Docker login/build, and CodeQL revisions in narrower security-owned PRs.

options.title: Pause this grouped update
options.body: Close or recreate the Dependabot group if a clean, security-reviewed head cannot be produced without repeated conflicting rebases.

recommendation.title: Approve after guards and rebase
recommendation.body: Accept the verified revisions once all three assertions are synchronized and exact-head workflow checks pass on a conflict-free branch.
